pattern.name: Epidural Steroid / Interventional Pain Responsiveness Model
pattern.frontend_language: interventional analgesic response prediction based on perineural matrix continuity
pattern.core_principle: Steroids (and equivalent interventions) work only when the EZ water grid is damaged but still continuous. They fail when the grid is fragmented (Yin deficient). Steroids behave as artificial Yang — they organise but cannot create structure.
steroid_mechanism: reconstitutes a thin EZ layer temporarily
compresses chaotic ion signalling into coherence
pattern.steroid_real_effect: Steroids momentarily stabilise a partially intact EZ water grid. They organise — they do not create structure.

steroid_works_when.EZ_state: thinned, softened, dehydrated, noisy, disrupted, inflamed — but NOT shattered
clinical_signs_strong_responder: morning stiffness that improves with movement (Yin still present — tissue can still glide on the Yin coating)
MRI shows oedema rather than collapse
pain improves with hydration or rest

steroid_fails_when.EZ_state: broken into patches, micelles instead of sheets, irregular charge zones, chaotic piezoelectric behaviour, venous sludging, fascial fibrosis, DRG degenerative hyperexcitability
steroid_fails_when.TCM_equivalent: Yin deficiency at tissue level — the inability to hold water in a coherent matrix. Steroid = Yang without Yin → no structure to consolidate → no effect
clinical_correlates: waking in pain during the night (severe Yin deficiency obstructs Yang movement)
severe insomnia + autonomic dysfunction (noisy fascia, sympathetically mediated pain)
deep cold sensation or dry fascia (fragmented Yin coating — morning stiffness does NOT improve with movement)
paradoxical flare after steroids (steroids further destabilise fragmented grid with energy entrainment)
history of trauma → rumination → organ tightening
MRI shows atrophy or severe foraminal collapse

pulsed_RF_vs_ablative_RF.ablative_RF: destroys tissue — eliminates signal but further damages EZ; fails in true neuropathic pain
pulsed_RF_vs_ablative_RF.pulsed_RF: recharges the EZ instead of burning tissue — works better because it is cosmotropic (field coherence restoring), not destructive

pattern.why_craniosacral_beats_steroids_in_chron: Craniosacral therapy restores Yin water continuity (cosmotropic) rather than Yang tightening (chaotropic). In Yin-deficient / fragmented-EZ state, this is the correct intervention axis.
pattern.why_herbal_Yin_tonics_succeed_where_ster: Herbal Yin-tonics + Shaoyang harmonisers are cosmotropic — they rebuild the structured water matrix and re-establish field coherence, which is the actual missing ingredient in chronic neuropathic pain.
